content.text: bash 도구 server="sandbox-server" 으로 opatchautodb 백업 및 cfgtoollogs 정리 후 install15 실행: (1) echo 'Welcome1!@#$' | sudo -S -u oracle mv /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0/dbhome_1/cfgtoollogs/opatchautodb /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0/dbhome_1/cfgtoollogs/opatchautodb.bak 2>&1 && echo opatchautodb_moved || echo opatchautodb_not_found. (2) echo 'Welcome1!@#$' | sudo -S ls -la /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0/dbhome_1/cfgtoollogs/ 2>&1. (3) echo 'Welcome1!@#$' | sudo -S -u oracle bash -c "export CV_ASSUME_DISTID=OEL7.6; export ORACLE_HOME=/u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0/dbhome_1; export ORACLE_BASE=/u01/app/oracle; nohup /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0/dbhome_1/runInstaller -silent -ignorePrereqFailure -responseFile /tmp/db_install_clean.rsp -waitforcompletion > /tmp/oracle_install15.log 2>&1 &"; echo install15_launched; sleep 30 && head -20 /tmp/oracle_install15.log 2>&1
